title: T1499.003 — Endpoint Denial of Service - Application Exhaustion Flood
subtitle: Watch one expensive search request quietly eat a database, and see what the SOC (security operations center) notices at the same time.
aria: T1499.003 - Endpoint Denial of Service - Application Exhaustion Flood

steps.title: Normal traffic
steps.caption: A legitimate user sends small search requests. Tokens move from the user through the application to the database and back. The database CPU gauge is green, around 20 percent. The SOC panel is quiet
steps.defender: EDR and Sysmon record the process, memory and image-load events. Correlate them with the parent process.

steps.title: Mitigation kicks in
